[B]
SQL:
WITH year_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    LEFT(collision_date, 4) as year,
    COUNT(*) as total
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY LEFT(collision_date, 4)
),
speeding_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    LEFT(collision_date, 4) as year,
    COUNT(*) as speeding_cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
  GROUP BY LEFT(collision_date, 4)
),
speeding_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.year,
    st.year as category,
    1.0 * sc.speeding_cnt / st.total * 100 as share_pct
  FROM year_totals st
  JOIN speeding_counts sc ON st.year = sc.year
),
most_common_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM collisions
  WHERE LEFT(collision_date, 4) = '2021'
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  mc.pcf_violation_category as most_common_category,
  ROUND(ss.share_pct, 2) as share_2021,
  ROUND(ss.share_pct - LAG(ss.share_pct) OVER (ORDER BY ss.year), 2) as change_from_2011_to_2021
FROM speeding_shares ss
JOIN most_common_2021 mc ON ss.category = mc.pcf_violation_category
WHERE ss.year = '2021'

WITH most_common_2021 AS (

year_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(substr(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        pcf_violation_category,
        COUNT(*) as count,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(substr(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) as total_year
    FROM collisions 
    WHERE CAST(substr(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2021, 2011)
    GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
)

    (SELECT CAST(count AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / total_year FROM year_shares WHERE year = 2021 AND pcf_violation_category = (SELECT pcf_violation_category FROM most_common_2021))
